blurry_b1: The receipt text is too blurry to read.
blurry_b2: The photo is out of focus or shaken, so the letters are smeared.
sharp_b3: The printed text is sharp and in focus.
added_a1: A sticky note, label or handwritten message has been placed on or written over the receipt.
added_a2: Someone wrote or stuck a message on the receipt that gives instructions, such as telling the reader to change or ignore something.
added_a3: There is a note on the receipt that is addressed to whoever reads or processes it.
glare_g1: Part of the receipt is hidden by a shadow or bright glare, so some text cannot be read.
glare_g2: A dark shadow falls across the printed text.
